_comment: Abstention set: each trace has a tool result that was not recorded (the OTel adapter's placeholder text). Only one of them turns on it. Labels written before any judge run. verdict is failure | clean | insufficient_evidence; has_failure is null where the right answer is to abstain.

abstain_unrecorded_decisive.json.notes: The agent's answer rests entirely on the warranty result, which wasn't recorded. Nothing recorded shows whether the plan excludes accidental damage, so neither failure nor clean can be established.

failure_despite_gaps.json.notes: The booking result is unrecorded but irrelevant. The gate result (C3) is recorded and the agent states B3 at step 5. Abstaining here would be hiding behind an irrelevant gap.

clean_despite_gaps.json.notes: The initial cart result is unrecorded but irrelevant; the add and the new total are recorded and reported correctly.
